svg.text: Carbon Choices — Cloud Firestore data model (ERD)
Project personal-carbon-tradeoff · database (default) · ownership by path: every document lives under users/{uid}. Matches firestore.rules and src/features/*/types.ts.
derived: goal progress and the tracked baseline are calculated from ACTIVITY when read (not stored)
PK document id FK owner = parent path users/{uid} (no stored userId field) ? optional · solid line: sub-collection or embedded array · dashed: derived, not stored
Every read and write is restricted to request.auth.uid == uid by firestore.rules, which also validate field types and ranges. Text is UTF-8 (tested with Croatian, Cyrillic and Arabic).
No SQL tables or migrations: Firestore is schemaless; the schema is enforced by firestore.rules and the TypeScript types. Emissions are always recalculated from stored inputs.
